article.headline: AI Weddings: Why Most People Are Using It Wrong — and How to Fix That
article.description: Level 1 is AI as a drafting tool. Level 2 is AI as infrastructure — systems that run whether you're paying attention or not. Most couples and vendors are stuck at Level 1. The ones seeing real results have moved to Level 2.
